_comment: Vendor corpus for the M0 gate (T022) and the corpus smoke test (T028).
The documents themselves are not committed: they are megabytes of someone
else's API and they change upstream. Each entry pins an immutable ref --
a sha256 for a single file, a commit for an exploded specification -- so
`make corpus` either reproduces exactly what these numbers were measured
Expectations are what lotsman reports today, not what it should report:
a change here is a deliberate answer to 'did support move, and which way?'

specs.name: kubernetes-apps-v1.json
specs.note: OpenAPI 3.0, self-contained JSON. The reference case for real translation coverage.

specs.name: stripe.yaml
specs.note: OpenAPI 3.0, 5 MB, form-urlencoded bodies and deepObject query styles throughout. The pathological-schema case.

specs.name: digitalocean.yaml
specs.note: Exploded spec, root document only -- the case of downloading the index and none of the 662 files it points at. Every reference is refused by name.

specs.name: gitlab.yaml
specs.note: Published as Swagger 2.0, not OpenAPI 3.x. A compatibility adapter is out of scope for this release.

specs.name: digitalocean-exploded
specs.note: The same specification with its files: a root index over 662 documents whose transitive closure is about 2,900 files and 14 MB. The reference case for confined file $ref resolution (T025).
